content:
Context: 9. Special Maternity Leave

60 days from the date of expiry of child soon after birth /  
In case Maternity Leave has already been availed and her leave continues till the date of expiry of child soon after birth / stillbirth, the maternity leave already availed till death of the child may be converted into any other kind of leave available in her leave account without insisting for a medical certificate and a Special Maternity Leave of 60 days may be  
granted from the date of expiry of child soon after birth/ stillbirth.
